admission.shape: the closed `config.theme` / `config.look: handDrawn` leaves, the closed `config.usecase` leaves including `useMaxWidth: true` and `colorScheme: rotate`, a quoted `systemBoundary "Title"` label and a `json <id>@{ ... }` block
admission.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 measured live
admission.twin_rule: the twin is the same fixture with the frontmatter removed; the art above the footer must be cell-equal

selection.rule: usecase originals whose only non-admitted inputs are the closed themed-envelope leaves, the quoted boundary title and the JSON block

review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial code review, fresh general-purpose agent, D-456 usecase themed envelope, 2026-11-24: round 1 REQUEST-CHANGES (mirror divergence, json prefix capture, look twin coverage, boundary keyword, CMake/ledger nits), round 2 APPROVE after fixes (task adc1bfd4d2bc4513d, resumed for the re-check)
review.note: The roster regeneration and the d117 counts are deferred to the post-approval OfficialMatrix rerun; both landed in the same commit.
